Messages.Author: J
Messages.Body:
Champion
[Reaction] Only usable when a monster controlled by another Methuselah
is taking a (D) action against you or against an imbued controlled by
any player. The action fails and the acting monster enters combat with
this imbued instead.

I take it that I can order this at any stage before the action is
completed. ie, If being bled, I can decline to block, let the bleed
be pumped up to ungodly ammounts and then cause it to fail with an
Imbued who has the Champion power?

I gather it's much like the Ordering of Archon Investigation.

Is this correct? If I use Champion, and enter combat, because the
action has failed - can the opposing minion continue it with effects
such as Form of Mist, Mirror Image and the like?

--> J

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
J wrote:
> Champion
> [Reaction] Only usable when a monster controlled by another Methuselah
> is taking a (D) action against you or against an imbued controlled by
> any player. The action fails and the acting monster enters combat with
> this imbued instead.
>
> I take it that I can order this at any stage before the action is
> completed. ie, If being bled, I can decline to block, let the bleed
> be pumped up to ungodly ammounts and then cause it to fail with an
> Imbued who has the Champion power?

Yes.

> I gather it's much like the Ordering of Archon Investigation.

Yes.

> Is this correct? If I use Champion, and enter combat, because the
> action has failed - can the opposing minion continue it with effects
> such as Form of Mist, Mirror Image and the like?

No. The action has failed. It wasn't blocked. Continuing a failed unblocked
action as if unblocked is simply continuing a failed action -- it fails.

Note that Mirror Image cannot be played at all, due to card text.
